name: Kettlebell Farmer's Walk
steps: Stand between two kettlebells, hinge at your hips and grasp both handles before standing tall.
Pull your shoulders back and down, lift your chest, and brace your core tightly.
Walk forward with steady steps and keep the kettlebells beside your thighs.
Hinge carefully at the hips to set both kettlebells down safely once you complete the distance.
tips: Avoid leaning forward, slouching your shoulders, or letting the kettlebells swing into your thighs as you walk.
Take short, crisp steps and breathe steadily behind a braced core.
